name: Adam
description: The first man, formed of the dust of the ground. He named every living creature, ate of the forbidden tree at his wife's hand, and by him death passed upon all men.

name: Eve
description: The woman the LORD God made from Adam's rib, and the mother of all living. The serpent beguiled her, and she took of the fruit and did eat.

name: Cain
description: The firstborn of Adam and Eve, a tiller of the ground. His offering was not respected, and he rose up and slew his brother Abel.

name: Abel
description: A keeper of sheep, whose more excellent sacrifice the LORD had respect unto. Slain by his brother, he being dead yet speaketh.

name: Seth
description: The son God appointed to Adam and Eve instead of Abel; in his days men began to call upon the name of the LORD.

name: Enoch
description: The seventh from Adam, who walked with God three hundred years; and he was not, for God took him. He prophesied of the coming of the Lord.

name: Methuselah
description: Son of Enoch and grandfather of Noah; his nine hundred sixty and nine years are the longest life recorded in Scripture.

name: Lamech
description: Son of Methuselah and father of Noah, whom he named saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands.

name: Noah
description: A just man and perfect in his generations, who walked with God. He found grace in the eyes of the LORD, built the ark at God's word, and was saved with his house.

name: Shem
description: Son of Noah, blessed by his father, and the forefather through whom the line runs to Abraham.

name: Ham
description: Son of Noah and father of Canaan, who saw the nakedness of his father and told his two brethren without.

name: Japheth
description: Son of Noah, of whom his father said, God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem.

name: Nimrod
description: A mighty one in the earth, and a mighty hunter before the LORD; the beginning of his kingdom was Babel in the land of Shinar.

name: Terah
description: Father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. He took his household out of Ur of the Chaldees to go into Canaan, but dwelt in Haran and died there.

name: Abraham
description: Called out of Ur to a land God would show him, and given the covenant and the promise of a seed. He believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

name: Sarah
description: Wife of Abraham, barren until God's promise; she bare Isaac at the set time when she was ninety years old, and judged him faithful who had promised.

name: Lot
description: Abraham's nephew, who chose the plain of Jordan and dwelt in Sodom. Vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked, he was delivered before the city was overthrown.

name: Hagar
description: Sarai's Egyptian handmaid, given to Abram; she bare Ishmael, and in the wilderness called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me.

name: Ishmael
description: Son of Abram by Hagar, of whom God said He would make a great nation; he dwelt in the wilderness and became an archer.

name: Melchizedek
description: King of Salem and priest of the most high God, who brought forth bread and wine and blessed Abram; Scripture makes him a figure of the priesthood of Christ.

name: Isaac
description: The son of promise born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age, laid upon the altar in the land of Moriah, and received back in a figure.

name: Rebekah
description: The wife found for Isaac at the well; barren until Isaac entreated the LORD, she bare Jacob and Esau and was told the elder should serve the younger.

name: Jacob
description: Younger son of Isaac, who bought the birthright, dreamed of the ladder at Bethel, wrestled until the breaking of the day and was named Israel. His twelve sons became the tribes.

name: Esau
description: Isaac's elder son, a cunning hunter, who sold his birthright for one morsel of meat and afterward hated Jacob; yet he ran to meet him and embraced him.

name: Laban
description: Rebekah's brother, in whose house Jacob served twenty years for Leah, Rachel and the flocks, and who changed his wages ten times.

name: Leah
description: Laban's elder daughter, given to Jacob first; the LORD saw that she was hated and opened her womb, and she bare Reuben, Levi, Judah and others.

name: Rachel
description: The wife Jacob loved and served seven years for; long barren, she bare Joseph and died in giving birth to Benjamin on the way to Ephrath.

name: Joseph
description: Jacob's beloved son, sold into Egypt by his brethren, imprisoned falsely, and raised to rule all the land. He told them, Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.

name: Judah
description: Fourth son of Jacob and Leah, who pleaded for Benjamin's life; of him Jacob prophesied that the sceptre should not depart from Judah.

name: Reuben
description: Jacob's firstborn, who kept his brethren from slaying Joseph; unstable as water, he did not excel, for he went up to his father's bed.

name: Levi
description: Third son of Jacob and Leah; from his sons came Moses, Aaron and the priestly tribe that bore the tabernacle.

name: Benjamin
description: Jacob's youngest son, born at his mother's death; the brother over whom Joseph wept, and the tribe of Saul and of Paul.

name: Dinah
description: The daughter of Jacob and Leah, defiled at Shechem, whose brothers Simeon and Levi avenged her with the sword.

name: Tamar
description: Daughter in law of Judah, wronged and denied her right; she bare Pharez, through whom the line to David and to Christ is traced.

name: Potiphar
description: An officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard who bought Joseph, and cast him into prison when his wife accused him falsely.

name: Job
description: A man in the land of Uz, perfect and upright, one that feared God and eschewed evil. Stripped of all he had, he said, The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away.

name: Pharaoh
description: The title Scripture gives the kings of Egypt. One set Joseph over all the land; another knew not Joseph, hardened his heart against the LORD, and perished in the sea.

name: Moses
alsoCalled: Moses the servant of the LORD
description: Drawn out of the water, called at the burning bush, and sent to bring Israel out of Egypt. He received the law at Sinai and spake with the LORD face to face.

name: Aaron
description: Moses' brother and spokesman, the first high priest of Israel. He made the golden calf at the people's demand, and his rod budded before the LORD.

name: Miriam
description: Sister of Moses and Aaron, called a prophetess; she led the women with timbrels after the sea, and was shut out of the camp seven days for speaking against Moses.

name: Jethro
description: The priest of Midian and Moses' father in law, whose flock Moses kept, and who counselled him to set rulers over the people.

name: Zipporah
description: Daughter of the priest of Midian, given to Moses to wife; she circumcised her son in the way and called Moses a bloody husband.

name: Joshua
description: Moses' minister, one of the two spies who brought a good report, and the captain who led Israel over Jordan and divided the land by lot.

name: Caleb
description: Of the tribe of Judah, who stilled the people saying, Let us go up at once and possess it. He wholly followed the LORD, and at eighty five asked for Hebron.

name: Korah
description: A Levite who with Dathan and Abiram rose up against Moses and Aaron; the earth opened her mouth and swallowed them up.

name: Balaam
description: The soothsayer hired to curse Israel, whose ass spake with man's voice. He could only bless, yet he loved the wages of unrighteousness.

name: Balak
description: King of Moab, who sent for Balaam to curse Israel and was angry when he blessed them three times.

name: Nadab
description: Son of Aaron who with his brother Abihu offered strange fire before the LORD, and fire went out from the LORD and devoured them.

name: Eleazar
description: Son of Aaron who succeeded him as high priest, and with Joshua divided the inheritance among the tribes.

name: Phinehas
description: Son of Eleazar, who stood up and executed judgment when the plague was among the people; it was counted unto him for righteousness, and he was given a covenant of peace.

name: Rahab
description: The harlot of Jericho who hid the spies and bound the scarlet line in her window. By faith she perished not, and she is named in the line of Christ.

name: Achan
description: Of the tribe of Judah, who took of the accursed thing at Jericho and hid it in his tent, so that Israel could not stand before Ai.

name: Othniel
description: Caleb's younger kinsman, the first judge the LORD raised up to deliver Israel; the Spirit of the LORD came upon him and the land had rest forty years.

name: Ehud
description: A Benjamite, a man lefthanded, whom the LORD raised up to deliver Israel out of the hand of Eglon king of Moab.

name: Deborah
description: A prophetess who judged Israel under her palm tree and went up with Barak against Sisera; she sang the song of victory that day.

name: Barak
description: Called by Deborah to gather ten thousand men against Sisera's chariots; he would not go unless she went with him, and he is named among the faithful.

name: Jael
description: The wife of Heber, who gave Sisera milk, covered him, and smote the nail into his temples; Deborah called her blessed above women.

name: Gideon
description: Threshing wheat in the winepress when the angel called him a mighty man of valour. He put out the fleece, threw down Baal's altar, and with three hundred men routed Midian.

name: Abimelech
description: Son of Gideon, who slew his threescore and ten brethren upon one stone and made himself king in Shechem; a woman cast a millstone upon his head.

name: Jephthah
description: A mighty man of valour thrust out by his brethren, then called back to fight Ammon. He vowed a rash vow before the battle and did with his daughter according to it.

name: Samson
description: A Nazarite from the womb, on whom the Spirit of the LORD came mightily. Betrayed by Delilah and shorn, he was bound and blinded, and slew more at his death than in his life.

name: Delilah
description: The woman in the valley of Sorek whom Samson loved, who pressed him daily until he told her all his heart, and sold him to the lords of the Philistines.

name: Ruth
description: The Moabitess who would not leave Naomi, saying, Thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God. She gleaned in the field of Boaz and became great-grandmother to David.

name: Naomi
description: Widowed in Moab and bereft of both her sons, she returned to Bethlehem saying, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara; and she took Ruth's child and laid it in her bosom.

name: Boaz
description: A mighty man of wealth in Bethlehem, kinsman to Naomi, who spread his skirt over Ruth and redeemed her before the elders in the gate.

name: Eli
description: The priest at Shiloh who taught Samuel to answer the LORD, but restrained not his sons; he fell backward and died when he heard the ark was taken.

name: Hannah
description: Barren and in bitterness of soul, she prayed at Shiloh and vowed her son to the LORD; when Samuel was born she lent him to the LORD as long as he liveth.

name: Samuel
description: Called by name as a child at Shiloh, the last judge and a prophet whose words the LORD let none fall to the ground. He anointed both Saul and David.

name: Saul
description: The first king of Israel, higher than any of the people from his shoulders upward. He was rejected for disobedience, hunted David, and fell on his own sword at Gilboa.

name: Jonathan
description: Saul's son, who climbed against the Philistine garrison saying the LORD can save by many or by few, and whose soul was knit with the soul of David.

name: David
description: The shepherd of Bethlehem anointed by Samuel, who slew Goliath, was hunted by Saul, reigned forty years, and to whom God promised a throne established for ever.

name: Goliath
description: The champion of Gath, six cubits and a span high, who defied the armies of the living God forty days and was felled by a stone from David's sling.

name: Abigail
description: A woman of good understanding and beautiful countenance, wife of Nabal, who met David with provisions and kept him from avenging himself with his own hand.

name: Michal
description: Saul's daughter who loved David and let him down through a window to escape her father, and who afterward despised him in her heart when he danced before the ark.

name: Joab
description: David's captain of the host, who set Uriah in the forefront of the battle at the king's letter, and who slew Absalom against the king's word.

name: Abner
description: Captain of Saul's host who made Ishbosheth king, then turned to David and was slain by Joab in the gate of Hebron.

name: Nathan
description: The prophet who brought David God's covenant of an everlasting house, and who said to him after Bathsheba, Thou art the man.

name: Bathsheba
description: The wife of Uriah whom David took; her first child died, and she afterward bare Solomon and asked David to make him king.

name: Absalom
description: David's son, in whom was no blemish from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head; he stole the hearts of Israel, rebelled, and was caught by his head in an oak.

name: Mephibosheth
description: Jonathan's son, lame on both his feet, whom David sought out for Jonathan's sake and set at the king's table continually.

name: Solomon
description: David's son, who asked for an understanding heart and was given wisdom and riches besides. He built the house of the LORD, and in his old age his wives turned away his heart.

name: Queen of Sheba
description: She came to prove Solomon with hard questions, and when she had seen his wisdom and his house there was no more spirit in her.

name: Hiram
description: King of Tyre, ever a lover of David, who sent cedar trees, carpenters and masons for the house of the LORD.

name: Zadok
description: The priest who stayed faithful to David through Absalom's rebellion and anointed Solomon king at Gihon.

name: Rehoboam
description: Solomon's son, who forsook the counsel of the old men and answered the people roughly, so that ten tribes tore away from the house of David.

name: Jeroboam
description: Solomon's servant made king over the ten tribes, who set up two calves of gold in Bethel and Dan and made Israel to sin.

name: Ahab
description: King of Israel who did evil above all before him, married Jezebel and served Baal; he coveted Naboth's vineyard and died of an arrow shot at a venture.

name: Jezebel
description: Ahab's queen, daughter of the king of the Zidonians, who cut off the prophets of the LORD and fed the prophets of Baal; she was thrown down from a window in Jezreel.

name: Elijah
description: The Tishbite who shut heaven three years and six months, called down fire on Carmel, heard the still small voice at Horeb, and went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

name: Elisha
description: Called from the plough by Elijah's mantle, he asked a double portion of his spirit and did many wonders: the widow's oil, the Shunammite's son, and Naaman's cleansing.

name: Naaman
description: Captain of the host of the king of Syria, a great man but a leper, who washed seven times in Jordan at the prophet's word and his flesh came again like a little child.

name: Gehazi
description: Elisha's servant, who ran after Naaman and took what his master refused; the leprosy of Naaman clave unto him.

name: Jehu
description: Anointed to cut off the house of Ahab; he drove furiously, slew Joram and Jezebel, and destroyed Baal out of Israel, yet departed not from the sins of Jeroboam.

name: Athaliah
description: Mother of Ahaziah, who destroyed all the seed royal of Judah and reigned six years, until Joash was shown to the people and she was slain.

name: Joash
description: Hidden in the house of the LORD six years as a babe, then crowned at seven; he did right all the days of Jehoiada the priest and repaired the house of the LORD.

name: Hezekiah
description: King of Judah who trusted in the LORD, brake the images, spread Sennacherib's letter before the LORD, and had fifteen years added to his life.

name: Isaiah
description: The prophet who saw the Lord high and lifted up and said, Here am I; send me. He foretold the virgin's Son, and the man of sorrows wounded for our transgressions.

name: Manasseh
description: King of Judah who reigned fifty and five years and did much evil, and who in affliction humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

name: Josiah
description: Made king at eight years old, who repaired the house of the LORD, heard the book of the law that was found, rent his clothes, and turned to the LORD with all his heart.

name: Huldah
description: The prophetess in Jerusalem whom Josiah's men enquired of when the book of the law was found, and who declared what the LORD would do.

name: Jeremiah
description: Ordained a prophet unto the nations before he was formed in the belly. He wept over Judah, was cast into the dungeon, and promised a new covenant written in the heart.

name: Baruch
description: The scribe who wrote Jeremiah's words in a book and read them in the house of the LORD, and wrote them again when the king cut the roll and burnt it.

name: Hosea
description: The prophet told to take a wife of whoredoms, that Israel might see her own unfaithfulness and the love of the LORD that would not let her go.

name: Amos
description: A herdman of Tekoa and a gatherer of sycomore fruit, no prophet's son, whom the LORD took from following the flock to prophesy against Israel.

name: Jonah
description: Sent to Nineveh, he fled toward Tarshish and was three days and three nights in the belly of the fish; then he preached, and the city repented.

name: Micah
description: The Morasthite who prophesied in the days of Hezekiah, foretold that the Ruler should come out of Bethlehem, and asked what the LORD requires of thee.

name: Joel
description: The prophet who called for a solemn assembly and foretold that God would pour out His Spirit upon all flesh, which Peter declared fulfilled at Pentecost.

name: Obadiah
description: The prophet whose short vision is against Edom, declaring that as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee.

name: Nahum
description: The Elkoshite whose book is the burden of Nineveh: the LORD is slow to anger and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked.

name: Habakkuk
description: The prophet who asked how long, and was answered that the just shall live by his faith; his prayer ends, yet I will rejoice in the LORD.

name: Zephaniah
description: Who prophesied in the days of Josiah of the great day of the LORD, and of a remnant left, an afflicted and poor people that trust in the name of the LORD.

name: Sennacherib
description: King of Assyria who took the fenced cities of Judah and railed on the living God; the angel of the LORD smote his camp, and he returned to Nineveh.

name: Nebuchadnezzar
description: King of Babylon who carried Judah captive and burnt the temple; he set up an image of gold, was driven to eat grass as oxen, and afterward blessed the most High.

name: Daniel
description: Carried to Babylon as a youth, he purposed not to defile himself, read Nebuchadnezzar's dream, prayed three times a day toward Jerusalem, and was kept in the lions' den.

name: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego
description: Daniel's three companions, who would not fall down to the golden image and were cast into the burning fiery furnace; a fourth walked with them, and the fire had no power over them.

name: Ezekiel
description: A priest by the river Chebar among the captives, who saw the visions of God, was made a watchman to the house of Israel, and prophesied to the valley of dry bones.

name: Belshazzar
description: King who drank from the vessels of the house of God at his great feast, saw the fingers of a man's hand write upon the wall, and was slain that night.

name: Darius
description: The king who signed the decree that no petition be asked of any God for thirty days, and who could not sleep the night Daniel was in the den.

name: Cyrus
description: King of Persia, named by Isaiah long before, whose spirit the LORD stirred up to proclaim that the house of the LORD in Jerusalem should be built.

name: Zerubbabel
description: Of the house of David, who led the return from Babylon and laid the foundation of the second house; not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit.

name: Ezra
description: A ready scribe in the law of Moses who prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

name: Nehemiah
description: The king's cupbearer at Shushan who wept for the broken walls of Jerusalem, and built them in fifty and two days with a weapon in one hand.

name: Esther
description: The Jewess made queen of Persia, who came to the kingdom for such a time as this and went in unto the king unbidden to plead for her people.

name: Mordecai
description: Esther's uncle who brought her up, who would not bow to Haman, and who was next unto the king, seeking the wealth of his people.

name: Haman
description: The Agagite promoted above all the princes, who sought to destroy all the Jews in one day, and was hanged on the gallows he had made for Mordecai.

name: Haggai
description: The prophet who stirred up the returned people to build, asking, Is it time for you to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?

name: Zechariah
description: Prophet with Haggai in the building of the second house, who saw visions of the branch and foretold the King coming lowly, riding upon an ass.

name: Malachi
description: The last of the prophets before the silence, who reproved robbing God in tithes and promised the messenger who should prepare the way.

name: Jesus Christ
description: The Son of God, born of a virgin in Bethlehem, who went about doing good, was crucified for our sins, rose the third day, and ascended; and He shall come again.

name: Mary
description: The virgin of Nazareth espoused to Joseph, who said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. She kept all these things in her heart.

name: Joseph
description: A just man of the house of David, espoused to Mary, who took her to wife at the angel's word and carried the young child into Egypt.

name: John the Baptist
description: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, who baptized in Jordan and said, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

name: Elisabeth
description: Of the daughters of Aaron, barren and well stricken in years, who bare John; the babe leaped in her womb when Mary saluted her.

name: Zacharias
description: A priest of the course of Abia, struck dumb for not believing the angel, whose tongue was loosed when he wrote, His name is John.

name: Simeon
description: A just and devout man in Jerusalem to whom it was revealed he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ; he took the child up in his arms.

name: Anna
description: A prophetess of great age who departed not from the temple, and who spake of the child to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

name: Herod
description: The king who was troubled at the news of the King born in Bethlehem, and who slew the children of two years old and under in all its coasts.

name: Peter
description: A fisherman called from his nets, who confessed Thou art the Christ, walked on the water, denied his Lord thrice and wept, and preached at Pentecost.

name: Andrew
description: Simon Peter's brother, who first found his own brother and brought him to Jesus, and who brought the lad with five barley loaves.

name: James
description: With Peter and John one of the three taken up into the mount; he was the first of the apostles to be killed with the sword.

name: John
description: Son of Zebedee, who leaned on Jesus' breast, took His mother to his own home, and on Patmos wrote the Revelation of Jesus Christ.

name: Philip
description: One of the twelve, who found Nathanael and said, Come and see; to him the Lord said, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me?

name: Nathanael
description: An Israelite indeed in whom is no guile, who asked whether any good thing could come out of Nazareth, and confessed, Thou art the Son of God.

name: Thomas
description: Who said, Let us also go, that we may die with him; who would not believe except he saw the print of the nails, and then said, My Lord and my God.

name: Matthew
description: The publican sitting at the receipt of custom, who rose and followed at a word, and made the Lord a great feast in his house.

name: Judas Iscariot
description: One of the twelve, who bare the bag, sold his Lord for thirty pieces of silver, and betrayed Him with a kiss in the garden.

name: Mary Magdalene
description: Out of whom went seven devils; she stood by the cross, came early to the sepulchre while it was yet dark, and was the first to see the risen Lord.

name: Martha
description: Who received the Lord into her house and was cumbered about much serving; at her brother's grave she confessed, Thou art the Christ, the Son of God.

name: Mary of Bethany
description: Martha's sister, who sat at Jesus' feet and heard his word, and who anointed Him with a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly.

name: Lazarus
description: Of Bethany, whom Jesus loved; four days in the grave when the Lord cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth, and he came out bound hand and foot.

name: Nicodemus
description: A ruler of the Jews who came to Jesus by night and was told, Ye must be born again; he afterward brought myrrh and aloes for the burial.

name: Zacchaeus
description: The chief among the publicans, little of stature, who climbed a sycomore tree to see Jesus and came down and received Him joyfully.

name: Caiaphas
description: The high priest that same year, who counselled that it was expedient that one man should die for the people, and in whose palace the Lord was condemned.

name: Pilate
description: The Roman governor of Judaea who found no fault in Jesus, washed his hands before the multitude, and yet delivered Him to be crucified.

name: Barabbas
description: A notable prisoner, a robber who had committed murder in the insurrection, whom the multitude asked for instead of Jesus.

name: Joseph of Arimathaea
description: An honourable counsellor who waited for the kingdom of God; he went in boldly unto Pilate and craved the body of Jesus, and laid it in his own new tomb.

name: Matthias
description: Numbered with the eleven apostles after the lot fell upon him, having companied with them all the time the Lord went in and out among them.

name: Stephen
description: A man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, the first of the seven; he saw the heavens opened, and as they stoned him he prayed, Lay not this sin to their charge.

name: Philip the evangelist
description: One of the seven, who preached Christ in Samaria and was sent into the desert to the man of Ethiopia, opening the scripture at Isaiah's prophecy.

name: Paul
description: A Pharisee who breathed out threatenings, struck down on the road to Damascus and made the apostle to the Gentiles; he finished his course keeping the faith.

name: Ananias
description: A disciple at Damascus, sent to lay hands on Saul that he might receive his sight; he called him brother Saul though he had feared him.

name: Sapphira
description: Wife of Ananias, who agreed with her husband to keep back part of the price of the land and to lie to the Holy Ghost.

name: Barnabas
description: The son of consolation, who sold his land and laid the money at the apostles' feet, vouched for Saul, and went with him to the Gentiles.

name: Cornelius
description: A centurion of the Italian band, a devout man that feared God and prayed alway; the Holy Ghost fell on him and his house while Peter yet spake.

name: James the Lord's brother
description: Who gave the sentence at the council in Jerusalem, and whose epistle says, Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only.

name: Silas
description: Chosen by Paul after he parted from Barnabas; beaten and in the stocks at Philippi, he sang praises unto God at midnight.

name: Timothy
description: A disciple of Lystra, son of a believing mother, whom Paul took with him and called his own son in the faith, charging him to preach the word.

name: Titus
description: A Greek and Paul's partner and fellowhelper, whose coming comforted him, and who was left in Crete to set in order the things that are wanting.

name: Luke
description: The beloved physician who stayed with Paul to the end, and who wrote an orderly account of all that Jesus began both to do and teach.

name: Mark
description: Who departed from Paul and Barnabas at Pamphylia and was the cause of their parting; Paul afterward called him profitable to him for the ministry.

name: Lydia
description: A seller of purple of Thyatira, who worshipped God; the Lord opened her heart, and she constrained Paul's company to come into her house.

name: Aquila
description: A Jew of Pontus and a tentmaker like Paul, who with his wife took Apollos and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

name: Priscilla
description: Aquila's wife and Paul's helper in Christ Jesus, who with her husband laid down her own neck for his life and taught Apollos more perfectly.

name: Apollos
description: A Jew of Alexandria, eloquent and mighty in the scriptures, fervent in the spirit, who mightily convinced the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

name: Felix
description: The governor before whom Paul reasoned of righteousness, temperance and judgment to come, so that he trembled, yet left Paul bound.

name: Festus
description: Felix's successor, who said with a loud voice that much learning had made Paul mad, and before whom Paul appealed unto Caesar.

name: Agrippa
description: The king who heard Paul's defence and answered, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

name: Onesimus
description: A servant who had departed from Philemon and was begotten in Paul's bonds; sent back no longer as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved.

name: Philemon
description: Paul's dearly beloved fellowlabourer, in whose house a church met, and to whom Paul wrote for Onesimus, offering to pay whatever he owed.

name: Jude
description: The servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, who wrote exhorting believers earnestly to contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.

name: Gamaliel
description: A doctor of the law had in reputation among all the people, at whose feet Paul was brought up, and who counselled the council to let the apostles alone.

name: Dorcas
description: A disciple at Joppa full of good works and almsdeeds, who fell sick and died, and whom Peter raised, saying, Tabitha, arise.

name: Theophilus
description: The most excellent Theophilus, to whom Luke wrote both his gospel and the Acts, that he might know the certainty of those things.

name: Gaius
description: The wellbeloved Gaius, whom the elder loved in the truth and commended for walking in the truth and receiving the brethren.

name: Diotrephes
description: The man who loved to have the preeminence among the church and would not receive the elder or the brethren.

name: Demetrius
description: The man who had a good report of all men, and of the truth itself, with the elder's record also true.
